ORIG.name: Original
ORIG.definition: The investor's written signature is required. Can also be known as physical or wet signature.

DIGI.name: Digital
DIGI.definition: A technical signature that includes algorithms and private key and public key information. Used to sign and verify the contents of a message.

ELEC.name: Electronic
ELEC.definition: A copy of a physical or original signature in an electronic format.

NONE.name: None
NONE.definition: There is no signature required in any form.
